scope: Local WSL Ubuntu preview and its U04 targets only; no remote development or production inventory

inputs: U01 catalog/reference contracts and U02 generation/negative-fixture records
Private credential handoff and six service input field sets
Generated platform environment field names and old platform environment field names
Current source routes, OAuth client update DTO/SQL, agent configuration loaders and targeted v4-generator scan

oauth_before_runtime_snapshot.meaning: ENABLED is the recorded database configuration status. It does not prove an RP was contacted or any grant was used. This is a pre-runtime snapshot, not a new live database read.

callbacks_and_rp.external_callback_source: The existing seed definition also registers a localhost callback; neither endpoint contains a platform UUID in path/query.
callbacks_and_rp.remaining_unselected_seed_callbacks: Two seed authorization clients include http://localhost:9000/callback; these are absent from the selected backend inputs.

old_application_entry_definitions.meaning: Old application definitions are inventory evidence; current target URL entries and actual frontend consumption require separate U05 runtime verification.

local_fence_decision.decided_by: Current root task within the authorized local maintenance scope
local_fence_decision.action: Disable only the precisely identified unselected seed client with the external callback in the fixed local U04 platform target

execution_evidence.first_default_read_only_attempt: UPDATE rejected and transaction rolled back before mutation
execution_evidence.successful_attempt: Explicit BEGIN READ WRITE, exact target/client gates and private before/after journal

preserve: client row and mapped UUID identity
required_gates: Exact target database OID and original ENABLED status
Exact single-row selection from the private inspected snapshot
No selected six-service input references the client
Old and new credentials cannot obtain authority while DISABLED

oauth_status_api_gap.unsafe_assumption: A status-only JSON body can be ignored and return a successful response without disabling the client.
oauth_status_api_gap.current_root_decision: Do not modify the frozen binary and do not send an ignored status DTO. Root applied the single-client fence through the controlled local maintenance transaction and retained private evidence.
oauth_status_api_gap.reversibility: Restoring ENABLED would be another explicit maintenance decision; original row, callbacks and client_id are retained. No such restoration is authorized or performed by this audit.

agent_and_webhook_boundary.meaning: No agent target/group is enabled by the inspected local configuration. Zero initial task counts are U04 evidence, not a fresh live runtime query. No historical external installation or publication effect is claimed.

opaque_values_preserved_by_contract: Business order numbers, idempotency keys and counters
Imported geographical source identifiers and third-party-owned identifiers
Canonical origin and callback URL semantics, except separately authorized owned runtime configuration changes
typed_values_rekeyed_or_reissued_by_cont: Platform user/tenant/organization/application/client-row/member/menu/role UUID identities and business entity references through their authority map
Owned application URL revision and registered work-order ticket route segments
Fresh session/jti/nonce/request identifiers under their separate validity and replay contracts

residual_v4_boundary.classification: All ten remaining matches are the already registered explicit rejection or historical schema/stage fixtures; line offsets may differ after independent identity work.
residual_v4_boundary.historical_migrations_and_sdk_releases: Remain original evidence; no blanket text replacement and no claim that repository text contains zero v4 examples.
residual_v4_boundary.source_v4_databases_and_old_signed_mater: Retained under the source/freeze evidence policy; not valid new-epoch credentials or active target identity input.
residual_v4_boundary.unknown_active_uuid_paths: Remain fail-closed under the reference registry; a regex match alone does not authorize conversion.

limits: No external owner or user confirmation has been inferred from seed configuration, lack of observed traffic or localhost bindings.
External debugger/RP account state and previous consumption of old sub are unknown; the local DISABLED fence does not prove their migration.
Remote development, production and integrations absent from the local snapshots remain unaudited.
Current callback updates, target service consumption, signature rotation and credential rejection are recorded separately by U05 execution evidence.
This file does not mark UUID-U05, UUID-U06 or Q4 as globally complete.
